looks.title: Four blades
looks.intent: The X alone: the 12 PARs under the arms at full cold white — in haze four blades of light hang from the truss to the floor, the DJ standing in the one along the bridge. Everything else dark.

looks.title: Red room
looks.intent: Deep red and low: the columns and the press glow from their feet, the bridge a red frame, the blades a dim red veil.

looks.title: Hit
looks.intent: The peak: the 4 COBs at full, out along their arms onto the floor, the crowd and the press (their own 1–25 Hz strobe channel on the desk); every PAR out, so the hit lands on black.

looks.title: One blade
looks.intent: Blackout, and only the crowd arm's blade: a single curtain of cold white reaching out from the DJ over the front of the floor.

looks.title: The sign
looks.intent: The X inside its frame: the four blades in cold white at 60 %, the bridge a dim red frame over them, the columns and the press a low red.
